release.description: Change to Central Portal publishing, reproducible builds, dbUnit 3.0.0, GitHub config, convert docs to Asciidoc, version bumps, auto-publish SNAPSHOTS
release.action: Setup reproducible builds.
Change Central artifact publishing from OSSRH to new Portal.
Update dbUnit version to 3.0.0.
Configure GitHub CI.
Convert APT and XDoc doc files to Asciidoc.
Generate and publish Maven site to GitHub pages.
Bump multiple plugin and lib versions.
Update github_actions dependency dependabot/fetch-metadata from 2 to 3 (#2).
Update github_actions dependency actions/upload-pages-artifact from 3 to 5 (#2).
Update github_actions dependency actions/deploy-pages from 4 to 5 (#2).
Auto-publish SNAPSHOTs to Maven Central on master commits.
Update github_actions dependency actions/setup-java from 4 to 5 (#14).
Update maven dependency org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-invoker-plugin from 3.10.0 to 3.10.1 (#13).
Update maven dependency org.slf4j:slf4j-api from 2.0.17 to 2.0.18 (#15).
Update maven dependency org.slf4j:slf4j-simple from 2.0.17 to 2.0.18 (#15).
Update maven dependency org.dbunit:dbunit from 3.0.0 to 3.1.0 (#16).
Create composite dataset from multiple source files.
Update dbUnit version to 2.7.3.
